description: This grouped bar chart illustrates an ablation study representing the performance of two different Critic model choices across three datasets, measured by Exact Match (EM) and F1 metrics. The horizontal category axis displays six evaluation conditions, ordered as "TriviaQA (EM)", "HotPotQA (EM)", "2Wiki (EM)", "TriviaQA (F1)", "HotPotQA (F1)", and "2Wiki (F1)", with each text label emphasized by a yellow highlight background. The vertical value axis lacks an explicit title and displays numeric scores on a linear scale ranging from 25 to 85, with labeled major ticks at intervals of 20 (25, 45, 65, and 85) and unlabeled horizontal grid lines at intermediate intervals of 10. Within each of the six categories, two adjacent vertical bars are grouped together to denote the model used, as defined by a legend in the top right corner that also features yellow highlighting: blue bars represent "Flan-T5-783M" and red bars represent "GPT-4". Exact numeric values are annotated in white text at the top of every bar. For the blue Flan-T5-783M model, the scores are 77.3 for TriviaQA (EM), 37.0 for HotPotQA (EM), 44.5 for 2Wiki (EM), 82.8 for TriviaQA (F1), 49.7 for HotPotQA (F1), and 53.3 for 2Wiki (F1). For the red GPT-4 model, the annotated scores are 77.1 for TriviaQA (EM), 31.9 for HotPotQA (EM) which is the shortest bar in the overall chart, 32.5 for 2Wiki (EM), 83.8 for TriviaQA (F1) which is the tallest bar in the chart, 43.3 for HotPotQA (F1), and 38.1 for 2Wiki (F1). The bars are not sorted in ascending or descending order by height, but are logically grouped by the evaluation metric and dataset.
